description: Returns the main text of one public web page as clean markdown, unchanged and not summarized, up to 8,000 characters, as {url, markdown, truncated}, usually in 2 to 5 seconds. Pass the address of the specific page, not a site's home page; pages that need a login cannot be read, and longer pages are cut and flagged truncated. Use page.summarize for a short version. To read several pages, or to crawl a topic, get the addresses from web.search and call this once per address. Read-only. Paid per call with x402, up to 60 calls a minute per client; a failed call is not charged.

url.description: Public http or https address of the page to extract; private or local addresses are refused.
url.title: Url

name: page.extract

markdown.description: Main content of the page as markdown, up to 8,000 characters.

truncated.description: True if the page was longer than the cap.
